content.title: Discover
content.text: Discover Your Premier Life Skills University Discover High Point University: Where Education Meets Inspiration At High Point University, we believe in more than just educating students—we empower them to excel in life. As the Premier Life Skills University, HPU offers an extraordinary education in an inspiring environment, surrounded by caring people who are dedicated to your success. We’re proud to be named the #1 Best Run College in the Nation by The Princeton Review in 2024, a testament to our commitment to providing the best possible experience for our students. Why Choose HPU? Academic Excellence: At HPU, academic excellence goes beyond the classroom. With a low faculty-to-student ratio, our dedicated professors serve as mentors, guiding you on your academic and personal journey. Experiential Learning: Gain real-world experience from day one. HPU integrates hands-on learning across all disciplines, ensuring you graduate with the skills and confidence to thrive in your career. Modeling Values, Building Character: We believe in shaping not just minds, but character. At HPU, students embody values like generosity, gratitude, a growth mindset, and civility, all while upholding our commitment to God, Family, and Country. Life Skills: HPU is about more than degrees; it’s about life skills. Our students learn practical wisdom and career skills that prepare them for success in any field. Access to Innovators: Connect with industry leaders through internships, mentorships, and networking opportunities. At HPU, you’ll have direct access to innovators who can help launch your career. CareerShadowing Job shadowing allows students to spend a half-day or entire day observing a professional on-the-job. Students observe meaningful work activity, the work culture of the organization and feel the flow of a typical workday. UndergraduateResearch HPU welcomes freshman into a culture of scholarly research as soon as they arrive to campus. While other universities focus on senior research projects, HPU presents research opportunities to students throughout their four-year journey. ServiceLearning Service learning breaks down the walls of the traditional classroom and brings theoretical concepts to life. Through service learning courses, students are embedded with real-world opportunities that relate to course material. Whether it’s English majors tutoring refugee children in literacy, or strategic communication students producing marketing campaigns for nonprofit organizations, students gain valuable skills and strong connections to their community. Our goal is to bring people and cultures together, to share their similarities and embrace their differences. Former U.S. Senator J. William Fulbright proclaimed that “International education exchange is the most significant current project designed to continue the process of humanizing mankind to the point, we would hope, that nations can learn to live in peace.” Show me a successful individual and I’ll show you someone who had real positive influences in his or her life. I’m sure there was someone cheering you on or showing the way. A mentor. - Denzel Washington 79% of HPU students come from out of state 110K+ hours of community service each year 100% of classes taught by faculty Choose to be Extraordinary! Find Your Counselor Today Pioneering Tomorrow Through Innovation Taking on the Major Leagues Staying Hungry for Success From Camcorder To Control Room Mentorship and Meaningful Interactions Your degree is not the thing that gets you a job. You will get you a job. HPU is a life accelerator – compressing time and allowing you to amass a lifetime of experience in just four years. You begin your professional careers as soon as you arrive on campus. You graduate ready for the real world. And the real world wants you. Explore the questions that you’ll encounter during your professional and personal life. Test yourself. Do you have the answers?
